evidence.quote: All subjects are taught in English.
plus €500 DIT service fee per semester for enrolled students
Persons with a nationality outside the European Union (EU) and the European Economic Area (EEA).
If you are interested in applying to our university, choose what you aim to study and apply directly to DIT via our own online application portal, Primuss.

notes: The DAAD page states a non-EU tuition fee of '500 EUR' per semester under 'Tuition fees per semester ... non-EU countries ... 500 EUR', but the programme's own page (th-deg.de/ese-b-en) says 'No tuition fees, only student union fee', and the university fee page calls the €500 a 'service fee' charged per semester to persons outside the EU/EEA. The figure has therefore been recorded as tuition at 50000 EUR minor units per semester. The tuition quote was taken from the university fee page because no sentence on a supplied page unambiguously states the €500 as tuition for this programme. Intakes: only the winter semester is offered ('Start Winter semester'), and the year 2025 was derived from 'From the application phase for the winter semester 2025/26 (start 15 April 2025)'; the pages do not state a start date (day/month) or the year of a later application cycle. Application channel: the pages describe applying via the university's own portal Primuss and do not mention uni-assist for this programme; however, the programme-specific table entry says 'University Entrance Qualification (Check DAAD Eligibility)' so eligibility must be checked beforehand. The Academic Readiness Assessment is also referred to as an ARLA test certificate in the programme table. The DAAD page also lists TOEIC, telc English B2 and PTE Academic, which were not captured in acceptedTests because only the first named tests were quoted.

note.fr: Tous les candidats à ce programme doivent passer le test Academic Readiness Assessment et fournir le certificat obtenu avec les autres documents de candidature.
note.en: All applicants to this programme must take the Academic Readiness Assessment test and provide the resulting certificate along with the other application documents.

evidence.quote: Applicants have to take an Academic Readiness Assessment test and provide the result certificate in supplement to the other documents required for application

note.fr: Vérifiez votre diplôme de fin d'études secondaires (Baccalauréat marocain) dans la base de données DAAD ou sur Anabin pour savoir s'il vous donne accès à l'université ; sinon, une année d'études universitaires ou un Studienkolleg peut être nécessaire.
note.en: Check your school-leaving certificate (Moroccan Baccalauréat) in the DAAD database or Anabin to see whether it gives you university entrance eligibility; otherwise one year of university study or a Studienkolleg may be required.
